hero.intro: As a professional artist, Haydar Durmuş has dedicated over 50 years to visual arts, and is constantly seeking innovative ways to develop newer skills. In this website; explore his 2500-piece portfolio, and discover his art house where he exhibits about 200 pieces of artwork from over 100 different painters. See his art studio integrated with the Black Sea nature, and find out more about his medium.
